page_title: JUV 2-0 MON | Juventus v Monza 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' What a poor attempt! Stefano Sensi (Monza) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
89' Monza can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Alberto Costa (Juventus) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
86' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
85' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
83' Michele Di Gregorio makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Gianluca Caprari (Monza) after a cross from the side.
82' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' Omari Forson (Monza) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Monza get a corner.
81' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Alessandro Bianco is replaced by Patrick Ciurria (Monza).
81' Substitution. Dany Mota did his best and is replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
79' Yellow card. Luca Caldirola (Monza) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:2.
75' Pedro Pereira (Monza) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
74' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Alberto Costa (Juventus) replaces Nicolas Gonzalez.
74' It is time for a substitution. Stefano Sensi (Monza) is on for Gaetano Castrovilli.
71' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
68' Monza couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
66' Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle after Timothy Weah (Juventus) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Monza will take a free kick near the side line.
66' 10:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
63' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Omari Forson (Monza) replacing Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Samuele Birindelli will be replaced by Andrea Petagna (Monza).
61' Great teamplay by Monza as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Savona (Juventus) was quite harsh and Daniele Perenzoni didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

59' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Stefano Turati is alert and denies him with a nice save.
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolo Savona for Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Cambiaso leaves the pitch and Timothy Weah (Juventus) comes on.

55' A precise low pass is received by Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

52' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Michele Di Gregorio, who pulls off a comfortable save!
50' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
49' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Perenzoni starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' He’s off! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets his marching orders from referee Daniele Perenzoni after the VAR review.

45+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), but referee Daniele Perenzoni must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45+2' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Perenzoni blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Samuele Birindelli (Monza).
41' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) commits a foul during an attacking move.

37' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monza are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

33' 2 - 0 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) neatly controls a decent pass from Khephren Thuram. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 2:0.
32' Daniele Perenzoni shows a yellow card to Renato Veiga (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
30' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
28' Daniele Perenzoni blows his whistle and it's Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
26' The possession of the ball – 57:43.

23' Good chance! Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
21' That was close. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
17' Monza couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
15' Monza enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

11' 1 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus). He perfectly collected a pass from Renato Veiga and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
10' A pass finds the feet of Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
7' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Stefano Turati, who pulls off a stunning save!
3' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Perenzoni.
